## 3. Production Case Studies & Featured Systems

1. **CSE Tech – ESS Portal (`https://csetech.diu.edu.bd`)**
   - Enterprise ERP & Employee Self-Service platform for project, task, staff, and payroll management, Git version control, Spatie RBAC, TOTP/Email 2FA, Cloudflare Turnstile, MCP/AI workflows, and Google Workspace + Telegram/WhatsApp/Facebook integrations.
2. **BMS Agents (`https://bms.theshoaib.me`)**
   - Hybrid Rust (Axum gateway) + Python (FastAPI) autonomous multi-agent runtime featuring MCP tool execution, LiveKit voice CallSim, Whisper STT, browser automation, sandboxed code execution, and RBAC guardrails across English, Bengali, and Banglish.
3. **BMS – Multi-Tenant SaaS & E-Commerce Platform (`https://bms.theshoaib.me`)**
   - Multi-tenant SaaS ecosystem with Super Admin, Merchant Workspace, and Customer Gateway portals, CRM, inventory, usage-based subscription billing, and Vision OCR.
4. **Doctor Portfolio & Healthcare ERP (`https://orthopedicsurgeonrahman.com/`)**
   - Full clinical platform and admin portal for appointments, chamber scheduling, patient records, live chat (Laravel Reverb), Google SSO / WebAuthn / 2FA, Docker, and PostgreSQL/Redis.
5. **Foundation Management (`https://ihaveaplanfoundation.com/`)**
   - Non-profit foundation platform handling volunteer verification, program management, and transparent digital donations (Laravel, React, Inertia.js, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare).
6. **Pan-Organ Net (`https://huggingface.co/theshoaibme/PanOrgan-4.1`)**
   - Unified 2D + 2.5D multi-modality medical imaging foundation framework in PyTorch across 5 clinical imaging modalities (CT, MRI, X-Ray, Ultrasound, Mammography) with self-supervised pretraining, Sparse Top-2 Mixture-of-Experts, and conformal calibration.
7. **DeepConnect Provider (`https://deepconnect.theshoaib.me/`)**
   - OAuth 2.0 integration middleware connecting web platforms to Google Workspace, Meta APIs, Slack, and webhooks with AES-256 token encryption (Next.js, TypeScript).
8. **SobujBD (`https://app3.csetech.diu.edu.bd/`)**
   - AI smart-agriculture platform combining **Spring Boot**, **FastAPI**, **React**, **PostGIS**, **Redis**, **MinIO**, and **YOLOv8** plant disease detection.
9. **Supershop Management System (`https://github.com/theshoaibme/Super-Shop-Management`)**
   - Enterprise retail POS, barcode, inventory, and analytics platform powered by **Java Spring Boot**, **Apache Kafka**, **MongoDB**, **JWT**, **OpenAPI**, and **React**.
10. **Kivorly (`https://github.com/theshoaibme/kivorly`)**
    - On-demand multi-service super-app (ride-sharing, food, grocery, courier, tickets) across 64 districts of Bangladesh built with SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, Next.js, and Node.js.
11. **Meal Sphere (`https://meal-sphere.vercel.app`)** — Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, MongoDB community nutrition & meal planning platform.
12. **Pregnify (`https://github.com/theshoaibme/Pregnify`)** — AI-assisted maternal health & risk monitoring platform (Node.js, Express, Prisma, MySQL, OpenAI, React).
13. **App Pro (`https://github.com/theshoaibme/app-pro`)** — Native Linux desktop utility suite written in Rust & GTK4.
